packages.name: Get-IntuneRbac
packages.title: Get-IntuneRbac
packages.description:
This script performs a comprehensive inventory of Microsoft Intune Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) by querying Microsoft Graph and exporting the results into multiple reporting formats.

Intune environments often contain dozens of custom roles, assignments, scope tags, and administrative groups that can be difficult to document and audit manually. This tool provides administrators with a complete view of who has access to what within Intune, helping improve governance, security, troubleshooting, and compliance efforts.

The script collects and correlates:
    • Role Definitions
        Retrieves all built-in and custom Intune roles, including descriptions and role identifiers.
    • Role Permissions
        Enumerates every permitted resource action assigned to each role, providing visibility into the exact administrative capabilities granted.
    • Role Assignments
        Documents all RBAC assignments, including group names and IDs for members and scopes, assigned roles, and scope tag names and IDs.
    • Scope Tags
        Inventories all Intune scope tags used for delegated administration and administrative boundaries.
    • Assignment Relationships
        Maps the relationship between administrative groups, assigned roles, scope groups, and scope tag names and IDs to show how access is delegated across the environment.

Generated reports can be used to:
    • Audit administrative privileges and delegated access
    • Validate least-privilege RBAC implementations
    • Identify excessive or unnecessary permissions
    • Document Intune administrative models for compliance reviews
    • Support security assessments and access reviews
    • Troubleshoot unexpected administrator access or permission issues
    • Create change baselines before RBAC modifications
    • Accelerate tenant migrations and environment handoffs

Output includes both human-readable CSV reports and a JSON export suitable for archival, automation, governance tooling, or integration with reporting platforms such as Power BI.

Reports generated:
    • ScopeTags.csv
        Inventory of all Intune scope tags.
    • RoleDefinitions.csv
        Inventory of all built-in and custom Intune role definitions.
    • RolePermissions.csv
        Detailed mapping of roles to Microsoft Intune resource actions.
    • RoleAssignments.csv
        Comprehensive view of RBAC assignments, members, scopes, and scope tags.
    • RBAC-Roles-Assignments-Groups.csv
        Relationship report showing delegated administration paths between groups, roles, and scopes.
    • IntuneRBAC.json
        Full RBAC configuration export for backup, analysis, or automation scenarios.

This script is particularly useful for Intune administrators, security teams, auditors, consultants, and managed service providers that need a complete understanding of delegated administration within a Microsoft Intune tenant.

packages.name: NetAppEfficiencyCheck
packages.title: NetAppEfficiencyCheck
packages.description:
This script will check for the following for a NetApp ONTAP 9.3 or newer cluster. Refer to the following ONTAP release note sections:
-https://library.netapp.com/ecmdocs/ECMLP2492508/html/GUID-2DF34D39-F6E5-4C73-887A-0B10ECF5A5FB.html
-https://library.netapp.com/ecmdocs/ECMLP2492508/html/GUID-2279167C-FF02-4E89-B1AE-16BB668A0F7A.html
 
Volume Information:
-Aggregate: Must reside on an AFF model. Available in all ONTAP versions that support that AFF model.
-Thin Provisioned: Volume space guarantee set to none and the space guarantee is enabled. Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Online:  Volume must be online to participate in efficiency savings. Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Encryption at Aggregate Level or Off: Either encryption is disabled or if enabled the volume is set to aggregate encryption-type. Available in ONTAP 9.6 and newer.
-Efficiency Enabled: Volume efficiency is on. Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Data Compaction Enabled: Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Compression Enabled: Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Inline Compression Enabled: Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Inline Dedupe Enabled: Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Cross Volume Background Dedupe Enabled: Available in ONTAP 9.3 and newer.
-Cross Volume Inline Dedupe Enabled: Available in ONTAP 9.3 and newer.
-Schedule Blank: The volume efficiency schedule is set to "-". Corresponds to the policy being set to auto. Available in ONTAP 9.3 and newer.
-Auto Policy: The volume efficiency policy is set to "auto". Available in ONTAP 9.3 and newer.
-Adaptive Compression Type: The volume efficiency compression-type is set to adaptive. Available in all ONTAP versions.
-Is Prioritized: The volume has not been deprioritized with the auto policy configuration. Available in ONTAP 9.3 and newer.
-Temperature Sensitive Storage Efficiency (TSSE):  Available in ONTAP 9.8 and newer.  Only present on new volumes created under those releases.
 
Aggregate Information:
-Name: The name of the aggregate
-Node: The node where the aggregate resides
-"Total Data Reduction Efficiency Ratio without snapshots and flexclones" or "Total Data Reduction Efficiency Ratio": Displays the storage efficiency ratio of the aggregate
-Volume Data Reduction Storage Efficiency Ratio: Displays the storage efficiency ratio of all the volumes in the aggregate
-Total Storage Efficiency Ratio: Displays the total storage efficiency ratio of the aggregate
-Used Space in TiB: Actual used space measured in TiB
-Total Space in TiB: Total space of aggregate measured in TiB
-Effective Capacity of Used Space Multiplied by Total Data Reduction SE Ratio in TiB: The "Used Space in TiB" multiplied by the first number in the "Total Storage Efficiency Ratio" field.
